intent_record.what: Replaced the direct return of the error code from platform_get_irq with an assignment to ret and a goto jump to the exit_pm_put cleanup label.

commit eb9913b511f10968a02cfa5329a896855dd152a3
Author: Zhang Shurong <zhang_shurong@foxmail.com>
Date:   Sat Aug 26 18:02:54 2023 +0800

    spi: tegra: Fix missing IRQ check in tegra_slink_probe()
    
    This func misses checking for platform_get_irq()'s call and may passes the
    negative error codes to request_irq(), which takes unsigned IRQ #,
    causing it to fail with -EINVAL, overriding an original error code.
    
    Fix this by stop calling request_irq() with invalid IRQ #s.
bic_trace_step.reason: This commit introduces the vulnerable construct. Specifically, it adds the check 'if (spi_irq < 0) return spi_irq;' which directly returns the error code instead of jumping to the error cleanup path. This bypasses the deallocation of resources allocated earlier in the probe function (such as the SPI master, PM runtime, and reset control), leading to a resource leak.
